key.name: style
key.description: auto: Blur My Shell's blur while it is enabled, else black. black: always black.

key.name: size
key.description: The pill's height: 4 px lower, the bar's height minus 6 px, or 4 px taller.

key.name: idle
key.description: shape: the black pill rests in the bar. hidden: nothing shows until something goes on.

key.name: bubbles
key.description: How many other running things sit beside the island; when more run, the last bubble counts the rest.

key.name: click
key.description: open: opens the activity below the bar. app: opens its app where it has one.

key.name: hover-glance
key.description: The empty island grows to show the next event, weather and stats while the pointer is on it.

key.name: hover-open
key.description: A running activity opens after 400 ms under the pointer, without a click.

key.name: pointer-pull
key.description: The pointer is drawn in slightly under the island, as on the MacBook.

key.name: notifications
key.description: Replaces GNOME's banners at the top.

key.name: osd
key.summary: Volume and brightness in the island
key.description: Replaces GNOME's on-screen display at the bottom.

key.name: fullscreen
key.description: activities: running things float 6 px below the edge, the empty island hides. off: nothing shows.

key.name: alert-length
key.description: How long a notification (5 s), a call (6 s) or a file request (8 s) stays open: 0.6x, 1x or 1.6x.

key.name: disabled-sources
key.description: Names of activity sources that do not show in the island.

key.name: quick-note-file
key.description: A Markdown file a right click on the empty island adds a line to. Empty: no quick notes.

key.name: lantern
key.description: A click on the empty island grows Lantern out of it; without Lantern it opens the overview.

key.name: calm-on-battery
key.description: On battery the island sets its sizes without springs and its level does not move.

key.name: level-animation
key.description: The level beside the music moves while it plays.
